description: Look up a business's Paycheck Protection Program (PPP) loan(s) by borrower name. Returns each loan's approved amount, jobs_reported (the headcount the business stated on its 2020-21 application), NAICS code, servicing and originating lender, approval date, first or second draw, loan status, and forgiveness amount and date. Names match from their first word ("Sumter Coatings" finds "SUMTER COATINGS, INC."); add zip to also match a word inside the name. Business borrowers only: sole proprietors, self-employed individuals and borrowers named as a person are excluded, and no street address is stored. Source: SBA PPP FOIA data, as of 2024-09-30.

borrower_name.description: Business name, from its first word, e.g. "Sumter Coatings". Suffixes like Inc/LLC and punctuation are ignored.

state.description: Optional 2-letter borrower state code to narrow common names, e.g. "SC".

zip.description: Optional 5-digit borrower ZIP. With it, a word inside the name also matches.

name: ppp_loan_lookup
title: Ppp Loan Lookup
